name: Gap direction set, then a retest of the opening range — cumulative delta agrees
why: The overnight gap is repositioning that tends to continue into the cash session (gap-agree cascade). The 15-minute opening range edge holds on the retest. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_sources.md). D: aggressor delta must agree, pre-registered 2026-10-17.

scan.when: flow && (!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1 && ((sign(gap) > 0 && lo(5,1) <= rhi(15) && cl(5,1) > rhi(15)) || (sign(gap) < 0 && hi(5,1) >= rlo(15) && cl(5,1) < rlo(15)))) && (sign(gap)) * cdelta > 0
